bio.text: Alex Mealer is the Republican nominee for Texas's 9th Congressional District, a newly drawn seat in east Harris County, after winning the May 26, 2026 primary runoff over state Rep. Briscoe Cain.
She is an Army veteran and was the 2022 Republican nominee for Harris County judge.
She faces Democratic nominee Leticia Gutierrez, a community organizer, in November.

sources.title: Alex Mealer wins GOP nomination for new Houston congressional district, defeating state Rep. Briscoe Cain
